name: GraphicsMagick
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
summary: Image CLI forked from ImageMagick, run as gm convert, gm mogrify or gm composite, emphasising stability and batch speed. Same scripting model and output as ImageMagick with fewer formats and effects. Adds nothing to the catalogue beyond a second binary for the same jobs.
use_when: Existing scripts already written for gm
avoid_when: General image CLI work: imagemagick has the wider feature set
Fast batch resize on big images: libvips or sharp

assessment.rationale: Maintained (Homebrew stable 1.3.49, release date not verified), but duplicates ImageMagick on the same CLI surface and libvips on speed, with a smaller format and filter set. No capability a catalogued neighbour lacks.
